query: select store_id, count(*)::integer as active_items, min(observed_at) as oldest_observed_at, max(observed_at) as newest_observed_at from public.retail_catalog_items where retailer_id = 'magnit' and active = true and store_id ~ '^magnit-[0-9]{6}$' and binding_id = 'magnit-shopcode-' || substring(store_id from 8) and scope_binding = 'public-store-product-page' and currency = 'RUB' and price_minor > 0 group by store_id order by store_id limit 1461;
